newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian shares end mixed before weekend.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian shares end mixed before weekend.

text.p: Leading issues of the Budapest Stock Exchange closed mixed with most of them changing only slightly in a calm session ahead the weekend, traders said.
"The market consolidated slightly after yesterday's rise," said Tamas Revesz of Gog Securities.
The BUX index closed at 3,533.09 points, down 24.85.
BUX index futures ended lower for five maturities, by 10.00 to 35.00 points, and remained steady for December 1997.
Among the most liquid papers of the market, OTP Bank fell the most, 110 forints or 4.51 percent to end at 2,330 forints, amid foreigners' sales.
After Friday's correction, traders said they expected the market to continue to rise next week.
